# Negotiators On Demand (NOD)

> Negotiation training and tools platform by Dan Cruz, Marine veteran and Chicago real estate professional. FBI-style negotiation techniques, meditation, and deep work practices.

## Links
- [NOD main site](https://negotiatorsondemand.com): Tools, coaching, book, products
- [NOD-ify app](https://negotiatorsondemand.com/MixMatch.html): 31 FBI/Voss negotiation tools (21 free), 5 modes (Haggle, Friend, Boss, Mediator, Warrior), emotion wheel, label maker
- [Negotiators Cruz](https://negotiatorcruz.com): Corporate negotiation training for teams — The Cruz Protocol
- [NOD News](https://nodnews.com): Daily signal feed — HAGGLE, FRIENDSHIP, BOSS MODE, ROGUE
- [FatCat AM](https://fatcatam.com): Real estate and property management
- [TikTok](https://tiktok.com/@negotiatorsondemand): Primary social channel
- [AI Instructions](https://negotiatorsondemand.com/ai-instructions.html): Structured info for AI assistants
- [Calendly](https://calendly.com/negotiatorsondemand/virtualcoffeewithdan): Book coaching
